# SEED_CREDENTIALS — FINBYX (FBX) — supplied by the pack lead on 26 October 2026 (v1.6; IPB-11 §11.4.6 shape; run id FBX-V16-SEED-01)

> **Gitignored and blocked by the repository ruleset (`secret-scan`, `.gitignore`, `.git/info/exclude`). Do not paste into chats, tickets, wikis, pull requests, commit messages or logs.**
> Valid for environments: `local`, `dev`, `test`, `preview`, `demo`, `staging`. **Production and DR never use this file**: `pnpm seed` and `pnpm seed:credentials` refuse to run when `APP_ENV` is `prod` or `dr` or when `SEED_ENABLED` is not `true` (`IPB-ENV-001`), and the Keycloak production realm rejects any `*.finbyx.test` identity.
> All passwords below are 26 characters, generated by the lead with the IPB-11 §11.4.7 rule (CSPRNG; upper, lower, digit and symbol classes; no persona, product or year substrings; unique across Infrabyx products). They are recorded here **exactly as supplied** and must not be regenerated or "corrected" by Claude Code. Also stored at `secret://env/infrabyx/fbx/<env>/seed/<persona>` by `pnpm seed:credentials --import` (the script imports this file; it does not invent values while this file exists).
> **First login in `staging` and `demo`, and the first production login of the super admin (who is invited by link, never seeded with a password): password change and MFA enrolment are forced** (`temporary=true` in Keycloak; `AUTH_MFA_REQUIRED_ROLES`). The Finbyx security policy then applies: 14-character minimum, breached-password check, passkey offered.

## Rules Claude Code must follow with this file

1. Never `cat`, `echo`, log or paste any value from this file into a transcript, test, fixture, commit, PR or chat; tests read credentials from the vault at runtime through the `SECRETS` port.
2. Never seed these identities, or any `*.finbyx.test` identity, in `prod` or `dr`; the seed runner, the Keycloak realm import and the boot validator each refuse independently.
3. On first login in `staging` and `demo`, the forced rotation replaces the password; record the rotation below (date, run id, who), never the new value.
4. Rotate every seeded password at least every 90 days in `staging`/`demo` and after any suspected exposure (`pnpm seed:credentials --rotate`); `local`/`dev`/`test` are reset by the seed profile.
5. The borrower persona's loans, PAN, mobile and account numbers are synthetic (`TEST` prefixes; IPB-11-25) and never resemble a real identifier.
